title: 223 By BP
description: EEG dataset recorded while participants received laser-evoked pain stimuli at fixed intensities (3/3.5 J for low pain and 3.5/4 J for high pain). Each participant completed three blocks of ten stimuli, with high and low pain intensities evenly distributed within each block. After each stimulus, participants rated pain intensity on a 0-10 scale.
methods_description: Participants received 30 laser stimuli across 3 blocks of 10, with low and high pain intensities evenly distributed. They kept their eyes open and fixated on a crosshair. After each stimulus there was a five-second pause, followed by a pain intensity rating on a 0-10 scale. The next trial began about 5 seconds after the rating.
